commits.message:
fix(progress): bar.complete, bar.finished and bar.pulse in Rich's rgb colours (rich-progress-p3gy)

Rich's DEFAULT_STYLES draw the fill and pulse in rgb(249,38,114) and a
finished bar in rgb(114,156,31); ours named magenta and green. The back
already defaulted to bar.back (grey23), so that half of the ticket was
stale.

fix(effects-feel): read a strip's text cells off the render its colours come from (rich-effects-feel-tupd) (#345)

A seam is told by what drew it, not by its glyph: the strip's joiner stamps
every seam cell with an owner, so an ASCII lead that draws nothing no longer
shifts the text set one column off the colours it is matched against.
